description: Line absorbers' k-distributions per 1 nm cell (rendering plan R08, R08.T4.d; decision-r08-t4d-kdist.md; decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md), written by apps/hyperion/scripts/atmosphereData.mjs k-distributions-merge from the fetched lines named here, which are not committed. The cells are in the binary parts listed, little-endian: HYKD, u16 version, cells, variants, temperatures, pressures and 0; then per cell u16 nm, u16 G, f64 ln sigma (m2 a molecule) of code 1, f64 its step, G f64 weights, and u16 codes over variants x temperaturesK x pressuresPa x g, g fastest, code 0 for sigma 0, else ln sigma = offset + step (code - 1). pressuresPa are air-equivalent broadening pressures; a two-variant table's values are mixed at fixed g by the self share of the Lorentz width. A cell of G = 1 is stored as its mean (decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md section 9). Reduced values; the citations are in NOTICE's Data section.
source: I. E. Gordon et al., The HITRAN2024 molecular spectroscopic database, J. Quant. Spectrosc. Radiat. Transfer 353 (2026) 109807, DOI 10.1016/j.jqsrt.2026.109807; CO2 lines 13100-26400 cm-1 (1204 lines: 12C16O2, 13C16O2, 16O12C18O)
terms: HITRAN states that its database and compilations are free (hitran.org/faq) and asks for its edition's article and the original sources to be cited (hitran.org/citepolicy); it states no licence: reduced values with their citations, the lines not committed (decision-composition section 5)
reduction: Each 1 nm vacuum cell's absorption line by line at each node (Voigt profiles, Humlicek 1982; HITRAN's air widths and n_air at the node's air-equivalent broadening pressure, S(T) by TIPS), each line's profile beyond 3 cm-1 times a far-wing factor chi and SpeCT's Eq. 11 shape (the quantum asymmetry x/(1 - exp(-x)), x = c2 (nu - nu0)/T, and its detailed-balance term) out to 293 cm-1, where chi < 1e-3 at every temperature of 100-500 K: two variants on shared g-points, SpeCT's nu3-band sets (Chaverot et al. 2025, A&A 702, A137, Tables 2 and 3, CC BY 4.0), CO2-CO2's (sigma 3, 50, 220 cm-1; B1 = 0.055 - 0.11 exp(-0.008 T), B2 = 0.021 + 0.08 exp(-0.0095 T), B3 = 0.01 cm; fitted at 218-751 K, Tran et al. 2011 and 2024, Burch et al. 1969) for self-broadening and CO2-N2's (sigma 3, 10, 70 cm-1; B1 = 0.416 - 0.354 exp(-0.00386 T), B2 = 0.00167 + 0.0421 exp(-0.00248 T), B3 = 0.019 cm; Perrin and Hartmann 1989's set marginally adapted, on their 296-773 K and Burch et al.'s 295 K measurements) for every other gas, mixed at fixed g by the self share of the Lorentz width. Table 2 prints CO2-N2's B2 alpha as 0.0167, a misprint for 0.00167: SpeCT's own code reads 0.00167 (gitlab.com/ChaverotG/spect-public commit e7c4579c08, fcts.f90, chi_CO2N2, a finding aid, no licence stated: one number read, no code used), Perrin and Hartmann's value, as 'marginally adapted' implies; against SpeCT's lab compilation (Zenodo 15564294) with HITRAN2024's lines the printed value errs -0.70 in mean ln(model/lab) at 296 K (Perrin and Hartmann) and -0.43 (Burch et al.), the coded +0.04 and +0.33. The check: CO2-CO2 +0.04 (rms 0.11) against Tran et al. 2024's 295 K data, Perrin and Hartmann's self set -0.71 (rms 1.10); CO2-N2 tied with Perrin and Hartmann's within the lab sets' own disagreement (decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md §§12-14). Each set's coefficients held outside its fit's temperatures, those nodes flagged (chiHeld) for R08.T10.a's bound on the body's own column, and nodes whose cell's intensity-weighted Lorentz half-width passes 0.25 cm-1 estimated (chi fitted in the infrared). on a quarter of the cell's narrowest Voigt half-width or finer; sorted into its k-distribution and reduced to two-point Gauss-Legendre g-intervals shared by every node of the cell, by bisection to 8e-4 in T over every column; temperature nodes 50 K apart, refined to 25 and 12.5 K where the chain test (cubic in T on ln sigma, the rows, the read cubic in ln p on tau) fails 2e-3; ln sigma stored in 16 bits a value (decision-r08-t4d-kdist.md; decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md).
